name: gdr-rtos-views
description: RTOS kernel state views for embedded debugging, driven by the GDR GDB helper

gdr.runtimePath.markdownDescription: Directory holding `gdr.py` and the `gdr`/`rtthread`/`freertos` packages. Empty uses the copy bundled in this extension; set this to run the plugin against a development checkout.

gdr.rtos.description: Adapter to initialize. Leave empty to use the probe result, or when the workspace has a single RTOS with an unambiguous version.

gdr.version.description: Exact RTOS version to initialize. Required together with gdr.rtos when the probe cannot read one.

gdr.autoInit.description: Initialize the adapter automatically at the first stop when the probe is unambiguous, instead of asking.
